notes:
Trakt works with the new kind of Trakt app, which has a client ID and no client secret. Settings > Connections needs just the client ID. On a phone or tablet, Connect opens Trakt's sign-in in your browser and brings you back to StreamMate. On a TV, StreamMate shows a code to enter at trakt.tv/activate on your phone, as before; phones can use a code too.

Trakt sign-in is kept safely: it's locked with this device's own key, renewed before it runs out, and Disconnect signs StreamMate out of Trakt too. Check connection confirms it's working. An existing Trakt connection keeps working; if Trakt has ended it, Settings says so and asks you to connect again.

A movie or episode you watch to the end is added to your Trakt or Simkl history straight away. Since it keeps playing in the small picture afterwards, it used to wait until you pressed Stop.
